## Stop: use the private channel

**Do not describe a vulnerability, exploit, credential, token, private key,
private traffic, or PCAP in this public issue.** Please close this draft and
report the issue through the private GitHub security advisory process described
in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).

If you are reporting a non-sensitive hardening question, provide only a brief
redacted summary and do not include reproduction secrets.
